display.purpose: Brand word and page h1 — the largest type in the app, deliberately modest (1.35rem/700).

title.purpose: Card and group h3 titles (1.05rem/600); h4 nested subdivisions (0.95rem/600).

body.purpose: Default text at 1rem/1.55; text-sm (0.875rem) is the standard density for data rows.

label.purpose: Uppercase letter-spaced micro-labels (0.75rem, 0.06em) at 65% opacity for fact captions and phase labels.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: The one permitted shadow — part of the daisyUI shadow-sm card recipe, both themes, no hover variant.

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Functional state feedback (hover tints, daisyUI transitions) at or under 200ms; motion is never decorative.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action; the app's default button size (btn-sm) at field radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem; padding: 4px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-primary, #2e7d4f); color: var(--color-primary-content, #ffffff); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary, #2e7d4f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: primary-coloured text and border on the card ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary, #2e7d4f); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-base-100, #ffffff); color: var(--color-primary, #2e7d4f); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary, #2e7d4f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The resting surface: base-100 on the base-200 page, hairline-toned depth and one whisper of shadow; extracted as ui::card() (px-5 py-4) with my-4 rhythm margins at call sites.
components.html:
Grow facts

Card body sits at px-5 py-4 rhythm on base-100.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-base-100, #ffffff); color: var(--color-base-content, #1d2b1f); border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 16px 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); line-height: 1.55; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Tile
components.description: The compact surface tier extracted to ui::tile(): hairline-bordered radius-boxed box at px-4 py-3 (env-strip tiles). The tinted live variants in live.rs keep full literals but share the tier padding.
components.css: .ds-tile { border: 1px solid var(--color-base-300, #dbe5da); border-radius: var(--radius-box, 0.875rem); background: var(--color-base-100, #ffffff); color: var(--color-base-content, #1d2b1f); padding: 12px 16px; display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; } .ds-tile-label { font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-base-content, #1d2b1f) 60%, transparent); } .ds-tile-value { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Fact Grid
components.description: Signature data pattern: uppercase micro-labelled values in an auto-fill grid (.facts).
components.css: .ds-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(10rem, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem 1rem; margin: 0.75rem 0; } .ds-facts dt { font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-base-content, #1d2b1f) 65%, transparent); } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; }

components.name: Ghost Badge
components.description: Transparent hairline chip for tags, traits and sensor roles.
components.css: .ds-badge-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.5rem; padding: 0 0.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-base-300, #dbe5da); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-base-content, #1d2b1f) 70%, transparent); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact field: card-ground fill, 1px hairline border, field radius.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-base-300, #dbe5da); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-base-100, #ffffff); color: var(--color-base-content, #1d2b1f); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-base-content, #1d2b1f) 55%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary, #2e7d4f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Two-row bench bar with a brand home link and 44px section links; the active page is underlined.
components.html:
Leaflog

components.css: .ds-header { padding: 0.75rem 0.25rem 0; color: var(--color-base-content, #1d2b1f); } .ds-brand { padding: 0.75rem 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-brand a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-base-300, #dbe5da); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--color-primary, #2e7d4f); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-header a:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-header a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary, #2e7d4f); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Leaflog looks like a tidy workbench in a professional growing operation: a flat, matte surface where evidence is laid out — dates, ranges, sensor readings, phase windows — and every tool sits within reach. Nothing glows, nothing floats, nothing performs. The system is quietly utilitarian: compact controls, plain labels, small unadorned cards that stack like index cards on the bench. Precision is the aesthetic; the personality lives in exact values, uppercase micro-labels and the phase-colour vocabulary of the charts.

The register is professional horticulture, never stoner cliché, neon-leaf branding or a dark "grow-op" mood. It is also not an ops dashboard: density stays low, cards breathe, and one concern occupies one card. Two complete themes — `leaflog` (light, default) and `leaflogdark` (dark, via `prefers-color-scheme`) — carry the same layout and the same component recipes; both must always work.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tonal depth: card surface (`base-100`) on page ground (`base-200`),
Two hand-tuned daisyUI themes carrying an incumbent botanical palette.
Uppercase letter-spaced micro-labels for data facts (the `.facts dt`
Phase accents reserved for charts: germination `#8bc34a` → seedling
System font stack; no downloaded or CDN fonts (local-first).

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: Every colour decision lands in both `leaflog` and `leaflogdark` at the same moment. A choice that only works in one theme is a bug, not a style.

rules.name: The Phase Accent Rule
rules.body: Strong hue is chart data, never chrome. The six phase colours and the today-marker **Marker Red** (`#e53935`) appear in Gantt/feed/chart contexts only; UI chrome stays green-and-neutral.

rules.name: The System Stack Rule
rules.body: No downloaded fonts, ever. If a future design wants a distinct face, that is a redesign decision with a local, self-hosted file — never a CDN.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is `base-300` borders and tonal steps. If a layout needs more shadow to read, the tonal structure is wrong — fix the steps, don't add depth.

dos: **Do** style everything through daisyUI semantic roles and theme
**Do** check every visual choice in both themes before calling it
**Do** use the `.facts` grid for state display and `btn-sm` /
**Do** keep phase colours for phase data; reuse the exact `phase_color`
**Do** mark the active nav state with the `aria-current` underline
donts: **Don't** add shadows beyond the card-rest `shadow-sm`; if depth
**Don't** load webfonts or any CDN asset at runtime — local-first is
**Don't** let chrome borrow chart hues: no phase purple outside
**Don't** drift the palette hue-by-hue — it is owner-endorsed as-is
**Don't** build dark-only or light-only styling; a `prefers-color-scheme`
